post.summary: Create or Add New Rule (Admin only)

post.description: Processes a batch queue of inspections recorded offline by field officers in low-connectivity areas. Performs idempotent synchronization, text extraction, and statutory compliance validation.

Upload 1–5 images of a product label (different sides: front/back/left/right/top). The OpenCV preprocessing pipeline will automatically run perspective correction, denoising, glare suppression, CLAHE contrast enhancement, and skew detection on each uploaded image. Returns full preprocessing metadata and image URLs.

get.description: Paginated list of inspections. Inspectors see only their own; admins see all.
Full inspection record including per-side image URLs and preprocessing metadata.

delete.description: Permanently deletes inspection record and all raw/preprocessed image files. Admin only.

post.description: Upload additional side images (e.g., back, top) to a previously created inspection. Existing images for the same side will be replaced. Preprocessing runs automatically.

get.description: Returns the preprocessed (color JPEG) image for the given side directly.

post.description: Executes dual OCR extraction (PaddleOCR and Tesseract) on all preprocessed images associated with this inspection. Reconciles character/token level outputs using spatial IoU alignment, Levenshtein distance metrics, and digit mismatch verification. Updates the Product record and advances inspection status to 'extracted'.

get.description: Retrieves existing raw PaddleOCR, Tesseract, and reconciled consensus matrix for the inspection.

post.description: Parses OCR consensus text using specialized regex and NLP rules to extract all mandatory declarations under Rule 6 of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. Populates the Product record with MRP, Net Quantity, Dates, Batch No, Manufacturer, Origin, and Consumer Care details.

get.description: Retrieves structured statutory declarations and confidence metrics extracted from the product packaging.

post.description: Evaluates the pre-packaged commodity's extracted declarations against active statutory rules (Rule 6 of LM PCR 2011, Section 18 & Section 36 of LM Act 2009). Performs repeat offender intelligence analysis, calculates fine liabilities, creates persistent Violation records, and updates inspection compliance status.

get.description: Retrieves all grounded statutory violations and penalty assessments for the inspection.

post.summary: Generate Statutory Inspection Report & Notice PDF
post.description: Generates a court-admissible PDF inspection report and statutory legal notice with ReportLab, embeds verification QR code, computes SHA-256 chain-of-custody hash, and sets inspection status to completed.

get.description: Streams the generated court-admissible PDF inspection report.
Retrieves aggregate compliance rates, severity breakdowns, and penalty estimates.
Returns daily inspection volumes, compliant counts, and compliance rates.
